name: M3_CRS610MI_Add
description: Create a new customer record based on an existing template customer. This operation adds a customer to the customer master using the template customer number as a reference. M3 validates that the template customer can be used as a basis for new customers, but the template’s field values are not copied into the new record. All customer data such as name, address, communication details, and basic control settings must be supplied explicitly in the input. On completion, the operation returns the new customer number and, where relevant, an explanatory message.

inputParameters.name: CUTM
inputParameters.description: Customer template number used as a basis when creating the new customer.

inputParameters.name: CUNM
inputParameters.description: Customer name.

inputParameters.name: CUA1
inputParameters.description: First line of the customer's main address.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number in which the customer is created.

inputParameters.name: DIVI
inputParameters.description: Division responsible for the customer.

inputParameters.name: LNCD
inputParameters.description: Language code used for customer-related documents and messages.

inputParameters.name: CUNO
inputParameters.description: Customer number to assign to the new customer.

inputParameters.name: CUA2

inputParameters.name: CUA3
inputParameters.description: Third line of the customer's address.
